headline: eTranzact nine-month profit after tax drops 42.7% to N1.38 billion
summary: eTranzact International Plc reported a 42.7% decline in profit after tax to N1.38 billion for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, down from N2.41 billion in 2025, driven by rising operating expenses.
why: Monitoring operating expenses and profitability metrics helps investors evaluate financial efficiency and cost pressures in the fintech sector.
